title: Localized tensor comparison commutes with a K-flat direct sum
statement: Let $R,A,B,C$ be commutative rings in universe $u$, with $R$-algebra structures on $A,B$ and an $E=A\otimes_R B$-algebra structure on $C$. Assume $C$ is flat over $E$ and derived categories of $R,A,B$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $Q$ be an $A$-K-flat cochain complex, $N$ a $C$-cochain complex, $F$ termwise extension along $A\to E\to C$, and $t:F(Q)\to N$. For any $u$-small family $U_j$ of $A$-K-flat complexes and arbitrary models $m_j$ of $U_j\otimes_A Q$ and $m_S$ of $(\bigoplus_j U_j)\otimes_A Q$ [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model], fix an integer $i$. Write $\alpha_j$ for $m_j.\mathrm{localizedComparison}_i$ followed by $H^i(\mu_F^{-1};F(U_j)\otimes t)$, and $\alpha_S$ for the corresponding map of the sum, as in [def-pc-localized-tensor-comparison-property]. There exist $C$-linear isomorphisms $e:\bigoplus_j(C\otimes_E m_j.\mathrm{cohomology}_i)\simeq C\otimes_E m_S.\mathrm{cohomology}_i$ and $d:\bigoplus_j H^i(F(U_j)\otimes_C N)\simeq H^i(F(\bigoplus_j U_j)\otimes_C N)$ such that $(\bigoplus_j\alpha_j)d=e\alpha_S$. No invertibility of any $\alpha_j$, $\alpha_S$, or $t$ is assumed, and the empty family is included. K-flat means that total tensor with every acyclic complex is acyclic.

proof.text: The proved BifunctorColimits preservation instances, with ModuleCat tensorRight preserving each coproduct via monoidal closedness and braiding, show that tensorRight Q sends the standard cofan of U to a colimiting cofan on U_j tensor Q. Apply the source-only coproduct theorem to this cofan, m_j and m_S, obtaining e and its summand localized-comparison equations.

Reuse the already proved generic shortComplexHomologyColimit and complexHomologyColimit helpers in Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.DerivedAmbientDirectSumsHomology (import all), specialized to ModuleCat C and Discrete I. ModuleCat AB4 gives exact coproducts. Compose termwise scalar extension, tensorRight N (using the proved BifunctorColimits instances), and degree-i complex homology. This composite T preserves the coproduct; (PreservesCoproduct.iso T U).symm gives d. Sigma.ι_desc proves the summand equation Sigma.ι_j followed by d.hom equals H^i(F(Sigma.ι_j) tensor id_N). Only the generic proved helpers of the cited module are used, not its scheme theorem.

Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ_natural_left_assoc and whisker_exchange give F(ι_j tensor Q);μ_inverse;F(sum U) tensor t = μ_inverse;F(U_j) tensor t;F(ι_j) tensor N. Apply Sigma.hom_ext to the desired square, rewrite Sigma.ι_map_assoc, substitute the two summand equations, combine homology maps with homologyMap_comp, and rewrite by this tensorator naturality equation. All remaining glue is Lean categorical composition, including the vacuous empty-family extensionality case.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_localizedTensorComparison_direct_sum_square
    {I : Type u} (U : I → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (m : ∀ j, BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U j ⊗ Q) C)
    (mS : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B ((∐ U) ⊗ Q) C) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)
    let α := fun j ↦ (m j).localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F (U j) Q).inv ≫ (F.obj (U j) ◁ t)) i
    ∃ (e : (∐ fun j ↦ (extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C)).obj
        ((m j).cohomology i)) ≅
      (extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C)).obj (mS.cohomology i))
      (d : (∐ fun j ↦ (F.obj (U j) ⊗ N).homology i) ≅
        (F.obj (∐ U) ⊗ N).homology i),
      Limits.Sigma.map α ≫ d.hom = e.hom ≫
        (mS.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F (∐ U) Q).inv ≫ (F.obj (∐ U) ◁ t)) i)
